organization.name: Lupine Science
organization.oneLine: Lupine Science measures where machine-learned models of atoms go wrong, against published references and pass/fail gates set in advance, and publishes every verdict, failures included.
organization.description: Lupine Science is an early-stage, founder-led research company. We independently measure the errors of machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), test corrections against preregistered gates, record any amendment made after results are seen, and publish the verdict: pass, fail or abstain. Correction is a research question here, not a product: it has held only in narrow, stated cases. Nothing we have published is peer-reviewed yet.
organization.mission: Make AI predictions of new materials checkable before a lab commits to them.
organization.contact: Research partners, model builders, press and investors: alex@lupinesci.com.

citation.preferredSentence: Lupine Science measures where machine-learned models of atoms go wrong, against published references and pass/fail gates set in advance, and publishes every verdict, failures included. LUPI is its browser viewer; Lupine Library is its public research record.
